title: ⚡ API Performance
description: Deep dive into API endpoint latency, error rates, and call volumes for the football statistics API.

queries.sql: select count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call'
select round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call'
select round(approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.95), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call'
select round(count(*) * 100.0 / (select count(*) from "web_events" where event_type='api_call'), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' and status >= 400
select api_endpoint, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' group by api_endpoint order by zo_sql_num desc
select api_endpoint, round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' group by api_endpoint order by zo_sql_num desc
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, api_endpoint, round(avg(duration_ms), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' group by zo_sql_key, api_endpoint order by zo_sql_key

select case when duration_ms < 50 then '<50ms' when duration_ms < 100 then '50-100ms' when duration_ms < 200 then '100-200ms' when duration_ms < 500 then '200-500ms' else '500ms+' end as bucket, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' group by bucket order by bucket
select _timestamp, api_endpoint, duration_ms, status, page from "web_events" where event_type='api_call' order by _timestamp desc limit 20
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "api_logs" group by zo_sql_key order by zo_sql_key
select _timestamp, body, severity, service_name from "api_logs" order by _timestamp desc limit 50
